kind: Sprint planning: scope cut, several owners, a deferred idea, an open business question

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: OK, this is planning for the next two weeks, version 1.5. We have three candidates: cloud saves, the new tutorial, and photo mode. We can't do all three, so let's pick.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: Cloud saves is the big one. We need a backend for it, I'd put it on Convex since we already use it, plus conflict handling when you play on two devices. I'd say eight days of work, maybe nine.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: The tutorial is mostly designed. The screens are done in Figma, I just need to export the assets. Implementing it is maybe four days.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: I can take the tutorial implementation. I did the onboarding last time, so I know that code.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Great. And photo mode?

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Photo mode is fun, but nobody is asking for it. I'd push it.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Agreed. So the decision is: cloud saves and the tutorial this sprint, and photo mode moves to the next sprint.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: Before I start on cloud saves, I want to write a short design doc for the conflict handling, because there are a few ways to do it and I want people to weigh in. I'll write it by Wednesday.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Perfect. Please post it in the channel when it's ready.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: I'll export the tutorial assets today and hand them to Ana.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Thanks. I'll need the animations as well, not only the static images.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: Sure, I'll include the animations.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: One thing we don't know is how much storage we get for cloud saves on iOS. Does anyone know the iCloud limit per user?

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: No idea. It matters for the save file size, though.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: I'll find out and tell Kenji before he finishes the design doc.

turns.speaker: ana
turns.text: Should we also add analytics to the tutorial, so we can see where people drop off?

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: I like it, but not this sprint. Let's get the tutorial out first and add analytics later.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: There's another open question: is cloud saves free, or part of the premium pack? That changes the design of the settings screen.

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: That's a business decision. I'll bring it up with Marta on Thursday, and we'll decide then. Until then, design it so it could go either way.

turns.speaker: nora
turns.text: OK, I'll keep both options in the settings mockup.

turns.speaker: kenji
turns.text: And the sprint demo, is it still on Friday the 14th?

turns.speaker: julio
turns.text: Yes, the demo is on Friday the 14th, same time as usual. Anything else? No? Thanks, everyone.

decisions.text: This sprint (1.5) does cloud saves and the new tutorial; photo mode moves to the next sprint.
Tutorial analytics wait until after the tutorial ships, not this sprint.
The sprint demo stays on Friday the 14th.
Until the free-or-premium question is settled, the settings screen is designed to work either way.

tasks.title: Write a design doc for cloud save conflict handling by Wednesday and post it in the channel
Export the tutorial assets, with the animations, and hand them to Ana
Find out the iCloud storage limit per user and tell Kenji
Decide with Marta on Thursday whether cloud saves are free or premium
Build cloud saves (Convex backend, conflict handling) after the design doc
Keep both pricing options in the settings mockup

notTasks.text: Photo mode (moved to the next sprint)

truth.notes: Marta is not in the call; the Marta task belongs to Julio. Photo mode and tutorial analytics were deferred and should not be proposed as tasks.
